title: Expand, migrate and contract
description: A schema change in four steps. Expand adds the new column; migrate writes both columns, backfills and switches readers. A gate checks that nothing still uses the old column before contract removes it. During expand and migrate both application versions work.

regions.label: Old and new versions both work

nodes.label: 1 Expand
nodes.detail: Add the new column; the running version ignores it

nodes.label: 2 Migrate
nodes.detail: Write both columns, backfill rows, switch every reader

nodes.label: 3 Gate
nodes.detail: No version uses the old column; recovery now rolls forward

nodes.label: 4 Contract
nodes.detail: Drop the old column in a separate release
